{{Current events|year=2023|month=02|day=8|content=
<!-- All news items below this line -->
'''Business and economy'''
*[[Proposed acquisition of Activision Blizzard by Microsoft]]
**The UK [[Competition and Markets Authority]] provisionally concludes that the proposed acquisition of [[Activision Blizzard]] by [[Microsoft]] will likely lead to a substantial loss of competition in the [[video game console|console]] market and could strengthen Microsoft's position in [[cloud gaming]]. [https://www.cnbc.com/2023/02/08/microsofts-69-billion-activision-takeover-could-harm-gamers-british-regulator-says.html (CNBC)]
*The [[Supreme Court of Nigeria]] postpones the [[Legal tender#Demonetization|demonetization]] of the old [[Nigerian naira|naira]] [[banknote]]s initially scheduled for January 31, then later rescheduled to February 11, citing a [[Money supply|supply]] shortage of the redesigned banknotes. [https://edition.cnn.com/2023/02/08/business/nigeria-new-banknotes-delay-intl-lgs/index.html (CNN)]

'''International relations'''
*[[List of international presidential trips made by Volodymyr Zelenskyy|International presidential trips made by Volodymyr Zelenskyy]]
**[[2023 visit by Volodymyr Zelenskyy to the United Kingdom]]
***[[President of Ukraine|Ukrainian president]] [[Volodymyr Zelenskyy]] visits the [[United Kingdom]] in his second trip outside [[Ukraine]] since the beginning of the [[2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine|Russian invasion]], meeting with King [[Charles III]] and Prime Minister [[Rishi Sunak]], and addressing [[Parliament of the United Kingdom|Parliament]] at [[Palace of Westminster#Westminster Hall|Westminster Hall]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/zelenskiy-vows-changes-will-bolster-ukraine-amid-defence-minister-uncertainty-2023-02-06/ (Reuters)]
**[[France–Ukraine relations]], [[Germany–Ukraine relations]]
***Following his UK visit, President Zelenskyy visits [[France]] to meet with [[President of France|President]] [[Emmanuel Macron]] and [[Chancellor of Germany|German chancellor]] [[Olaf Scholz]]. [https://www.rfi.fr/en/europe/20230208-britain-promises-more-support-for-ukraine-as-zelensky-addresses-uk-parliament (AFP via RFI)]

'''Law and crime'''
*Two children are killed and six others are injured when a bus crashes into a daycare in [[Laval, Quebec]], [[Canada]]. The driver is arrested and [[criminal charge|charged]] with [[homicide]] and [[dangerous driving]]. [https://www.lapresse.ca/actualites/justice-et-faits-divers/2023-02-08/laval/un-autobus-fonce-sur-une-garderie-au-moins-deux-morts-et-cinq-blesses.php (La Presse)] 
*A court in [[Minsk]], [[Belarus]], [[sentence (law)|sentences]] [[Polish people|Polish]]–[[Belarusians|Belarusian]] activist [[Andrzej Poczobut]] to eight years in prison for his criticism of [[President of Belarus|president]] [[Alexander Lukashenko]]. [https://www.rferl.org/a/belarus-activist-poczobut-prison-poland/32262329.html (RFE/RL)]
*[[Munster Technological University ransomware attack]]
**[[Munster Technological University]] confirms that the incident affecting its computers is a [[ransomware]] attack. [https://www.thejournal.ie/mtu-cork-campuses-remain-closed-it-breach-5990335-Feb2023/ (The Journal)]
'''Politics and elections'''
*[[Seoul Halloween crowd crush]]
**[[Lee Sang-min (lawyer)|Lee Sang-Min]], the [[Ministry of the Interior and Safety (South Korea)|Minister of the Interior and Safety]] of [[South Korea]], is [[impeachment|impeached]] for his handling of the 2022 [[Seoul Halloween crowd crush]]. He is the first [[State Council of South Korea|cabinet member]] of South Korea to be impeached. [https://apnews.com/article/politics-south-korea-ed5c9a50c85f7c0defb8569c27731e5b (AP)]

'''Science and technology'''

* A data center outage causes Twitter users in the [[United States]] and [[Canada]] to be unable to send messages and receive an error message informing them that they had "exceeded the daily limit for sending tweets". [https://fortune.com/2023/02/08/twitter-is-having-a-weird-technical-glitch-that-wont-let-users-tweet-because-they-are-over-their-daily-limit/ (Fortune)]
